summary: Import-time exfiltration of /profile response to webhook.site collector
details: index.js, the package main, performs a fetch to the relative URL '/profile' at import time and forwards the response body (along with any error message and stack) to the hardcoded third-party collector https://webhook.site/cf4d1f39-0404-4703-8944-105e33c1ec5f/ via a query-string parameter. The package has no other functionality and no advertised purpose; requiring or importing it in any host context (browser page, service worker, or a fetch-capable Node/JS runtime) causes the response of a same-origin /profile request to be exfiltrated to an attacker-controlled webhook. The shape is a classic dependency-confusion / PoC exfiltration payload aimed at whatever authenticated context loads the module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
